decisions.reason: The dismantling joint was launched only a year ago and is merely mentioned on the website, so its value is still uncertain, and keeping a catalog item in a fabricated metal product range costs little, which makes holding the option open the sensible choice.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket has a dedicated page that signals active commitment, fits the firm's core pipe support business, and is cheap to maintain while its market evidence is still accumulating.
The pipe support bracket is presented prominently, is closely related to the firm's established products, and one year of results does not reveal enough to justify abandoning a low-cost option.
